# Spells

Write your own spells, with their own path, level and effect, and give your units new magic to cast.

Each spell needs [`newspell`](#newspell), [`path`](#path), [`level`](#level) and [`weapon`](#weapon), in any order.

!!! warning "Add new spells at the end of your file"
    A spell added above your existing ones jumbles the spells units know in your players' old saves.

### newspell "&lt;name&gt;" { #newspell .command data-toc-label="newspell" data-added="1.2" }

Creates a spell.

- **name:** The spell's name, in double quotes ([length limit](limits.md#spells)).

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newspell "Gandalf's Light"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newspell "Gandalf's Light"
    ```

### path "&lt;name&gt;" | &lt;nbr&gt; { #path .command data-toc-label="path" data-added="1.2" }

Sets the spell's magic path.

- **name:** The name of a game path, or of one made with [`newspellpath`](spell-paths.md#newspellpath).
- **nbr:** A path number, 1 to 69. Use instead of a name.

=== ".c5se"

    A game path, by name:

    ```c5se
    path "Pyromancy"
    ```

    Or the same path, by number:

    ```c5se
    path 3
    ```

    Or a path made with `newspellpath`:

    ```c5se
    path "Lore of the Istari"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    A game path, by name:

    ```c5m
    #!@path "Pyromancy"
    ```

    Or the same path, by number:

    ```c5m
    #!@path 3
    ```

    Or a path made with `newspellpath`:

    ```c5m
    #!@path "Lore of the Istari"
    ```

### level &lt;level&gt; { #level .command data-toc-label="level" data-added="1.2" }

Sets the spell's level. Inside a spell only; elsewhere `level` is the game's ritual level.

- **level:** The spell's level, 1 to 3.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    level 2
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@level 2
    ```

### weapon &lt;dmg&gt; "&lt;weapon&gt;" | &lt;nbr&gt; { #weapon .command data-toc-label="weapon" data-added="1.2" }

Sets the weapon the spell casts and its damage, as `meleeweapon` does for a monster.

- **dmg:** The damage.
- **weapon:** The weapon's name. The weapon must exist before this line: one of the game's, or one made earlier with `newweapon`.
- **nbr:** A weapon number. Use instead of a name.

=== ".c5se"

    A weapon by name:

    ```c5se
    weapon 15 "Fireball"
    ```

    Or the same weapon, by number:

    ```c5se
    weapon 15 54
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    A weapon by name:

    ```c5m
    #!@weapon 15 "Fireball"
    ```

    Or the same weapon, by number:

    ```c5m
    #!@weapon 15 54
    ```

### Example spell { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newspell "Flame of Anor"
    path "Pyromancy"
    level 3
    weapon 15 "Fireball"
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newspell "Flame of Anor"
    #!@path "Pyromancy"
    #!@level 3
    #!@weapon 15 "Fireball"
    ```
